mappings.claim_limit: A compiled interface boundary is not a capability instance, implementation, adoption, or conformance proof.
The Entity carries one immutable projection and never becomes the authority source for projected records.
Definition records remain projections of definition-owned sources.
Product records remain projections of product-owned sources.
Project records remain projections of Project-owned sources.
Ontology records remain projections of ontology-owned sources and registered currentness state.
The Query projects inspect-only behavior and authorizes no semantic mutation or Project action.
Essays is represented as an entry; the Workspace does not acquire Essays ownership or runtime authority.
